payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

supports.question: Is a frog visibly present inside the toilet bowl?
supports.criteria: Pass if the image clearly shows a frog within the toilet bowl; fail if the bowl is visible and no frog is inside it; unknown if the bowl or its contents cannot be assessed reliably.
supports.binding: Assess the frog’s placement relative to the toilet bowl in the image, using the toilet in the input image as the reference. A frog elsewhere does not satisfy this check.

supports.question: Does the image provide sufficient evidence to determine whether the requested frog-in-toilet edit was made?
supports.criteria: Pass if the toilet bowl and its contents are sufficiently visible to assess whether a frog is inside; fail if the image clearly shows the bowl but no frog inside; unknown if visibility or image evidence is insufficient. This check supplies evidence only and does not independently establish completion.
supports.binding: Use only visible image evidence about the toilet bowl and its contents; unrelated edits do not count as progress.

parsed.fulfillment_criteria: For R1, complete if s1 passes. Absent if s1 fails and there is no visible evidence of partial progress toward placing a frog inside the toilet. Partial if the image shows some progress toward placing a frog inside but does not clearly show a frog within the bowl. Unknown if required evidence is insufficient or unresolved; do not infer completion or absence from uncertainty. Unrelated edits are not progress.
